# write-opportunity

Captures a product opportunity — a signal, pain point, or intuition worth exploring before any solution is committed. You describe what you observed; the skill shapes it through conversation, drafts the opportunity, and registers it on GitHub.

## When to use

Say "write an opportunity", "register this idea", "log this as an opportunity", or "we should explore X someday".

## What it produces

A GitHub issue labelled `opportunity` with only the fields that have content:
- **Signal** — what was observed, heard, or intuited
- **Who it affects** — user, role, or context (if known)
- **Potential value** — why it might matter (if known)
- **Open questions** — what needs answering before committing (if known)

## Closing nudge

After creation: "Opportunity #NNN registered. When you're ready to evaluate it, say `explore issue NNN`."
